client.name: Example Client
limitations: mild left shoulder discomfort on flat barbell bench

strategy.rationale: Four available days makes Upper/Lower the best fit: every muscle group is trained twice weekly, which beats a once-weekly body-part split at equal volume, and 60-minute sessions comfortably hold 5-6 exercises with proper rest. A PPL split would need 6 days to give the same frequency.
strategy.weekly_volume_notes: Roughly 14-18 hard sets per major muscle group per week — mid-range for an intermediate lifter. Starting at the lower end so there is room to add volume across the block rather than starting maxed out.
strategy.progression_model: Double progression. Hit the top of the prescribed rep range on all sets with clean technique, then add load (2.5 kg upper, 5 kg lower) and return to the bottom of the range.
strategy.deload_policy: Week 7, or earlier if performance drops two weeks running. Deload = same exercises, same loads, half the sets.
assumptions: Training Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri — adjust if your week looks different
Shoulder discomfort is non-acute and not under treatment; flat barbell bench is replaced with neutral-grip dumbbell pressing throughout
Access to a standard commercial gym with no equipment queueing problems
No medical restriction on heavy lower-body loading

sessions.name: Upper A
warmup: Shoulder CARs or arm circles 30s each direction
Ramp-up sets on first press: empty/light, 40%, 60%, 80%

exercises.name: Neutral-grip dumbbell bench press
exercises.load_guidance: Start where 8 reps feels like 2 left in the tank
exercises.cues: Shoulder blades down and back; elbows ~45 degrees from torso
exercises.note: Neutral grip substituted for flat barbell to spare the left shoulder

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.load_guidance: No torso swing — the chest pad is the honesty check
exercises.cues: Lead with the elbow; pull to the lower ribs

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cues: Drive elbows down to the pockets; full stretch at the top

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.cues: Ribs down; don't lean back into it

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.cues: Lead with the elbow; stop at shoulder height

exercises.name: Cable triceps pushdown
exercises.cues: Elbows pinned to your sides

sessions.name: Lower A
warmup: Ramp-up sets on squat: empty bar, 40%, 60%, 80%

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.load_guidance: Heaviest lift of the week — take the full rest
exercises.cues: Brace before you descend; chest up through the drive

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.cues: Push the hips back; stop where the hamstrings run out, not the floor

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.cues: Torso tall; weight through the front heel

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.cues: Control the return — don't let it snap back
exercises.alternative: Lying leg curl or Nordic curl eccentrics

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.cues: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.cues: 30-45 degree bench; elbows tucked slightly
exercises.note: Incline and neutral/semi-neutral grip keep the shoulder comfortable

exercises.name: Pull-up (assisted if needed)
exercises.load_guidance: Add load once you clear 10 clean reps
exercises.cues: Dead hang start; full range beats extra reps

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row
exercises.cues: No rotation through the torso

exercises.name: Cable chest fly
exercises.cues: Soft elbows, fixed angle; squeeze without shrugging

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.cues: Pull to the forehead; externally rotate at the end

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
exercises.cues: Full stretch at the bottom

exercises.name: Trap-bar deadlift
exercises.load_guidance: Heaviest pull of the week; reset each rep
exercises.cues: Push the floor away; lats engaged

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.cues: Ribs down, chin tucked; pause at the top

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cues: Don't let the low back round at the bottom

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.cues: Controlled step; knee tracks over the foot

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.cues: Posteriorly tilt the pelvis; no swinging

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
exercises.cues: Slow eccentric, full stretch

benchmarks.how: Work up to a clean top set of 5 with 1 RIR
Top set of 5, technique must hold
Sessions completed divided by sessions planned — the dashboard calculates it
Weekly average, same conditions; single readings are noise

recovery.sleep: 7 hours is workable; 8 would noticeably improve recovery at this volume. If sleep drops below 6 for a week, cut the last set of each isolation exercise rather than pushing through.
recovery.nutrition_note: Muscle gain needs a small calorie surplus and roughly 1.6-2.2 g protein per kg bodyweight per day. This is general guidance, not a meal plan.
recovery.deload_trigger: Week 7 as scheduled, or earlier if performance declines two weeks in a row, joints ache persistently, or sleep degrades.
recovery.notes: A desk job with ~6k steps means low baseline activity. Adding 2-3k steps daily will help recovery and body composition more than adding training volume.
